Section 4

BR-UK AI Webinars and Advice Sessions

Start by watching BR-UK’s three AI webinars on using AI in behavioural research. Then explore the advice-session recordings for specific questions and expert guidance.

All recordings are hosted on the University of Edinburgh's media platform and do not contain adverts.

BR-UK AI Webinars

  • Using Artificial Intelligence to improve Behavioural Research Watch the webinar recording
  • Using Analytic AI to improve Behavioural Research Watch the webinar recording
  • Responsible use of AI in behavioural research Watch the webinar recording

AI advice sessions

After watching the webinars, explore recordings of BR-UK’s three advice sessions. These sessions were designed for researchers who wanted to ask specific questions or seek expert advice about using AI in behavioural research.

  • September 2025 — BR-UK AI Advice Session 1 Watch the first of three sessions
  • November 2025 — BR-UK AI Advice Session 2 Watch the second of three sessions
  • January 2026 — BR-UK AI Advice Session 3 Watch the third of three sessions
